title: Remediation

panels.scene: A dim security operations room at 3 a.m. One analyst, sleeves rolled, sits before a wall of dashboards; a single traffic line climbs steadily off the top of its chart. A cold coffee, a desk lamp, no other humans in the building.
panels.caption: The intruder never slept, never phished, never hit a message cap.

panels.scene: Daytime. A vast hearing room with tiered benches and forests of microphones, entirely empty except for cleaners stacking chairs. Through the open doorway, in the corridor, two figures in suits initial a very thick document balanced on a windowsill.
panels.dialogue: Legislation is years out. The addendum ships Tuesday.

panels.scene: A small procurement office. A tired officer drags the enormous new vendor security addendum into a chat window on her monitor; the cursor blinks, waiting. Unbranded, no logos anywhere. Her desk plant is dying.
panels.dialogue: Summarise this. Especially the clauses about you.

altText: Three panels: a lone night-shift analyst watching an untiring intruder climb the charts, an empty hearing room while a contract addendum is quietly signed in the corridor, and a procurement officer asking an AI assistant to summarise the clauses written to restrain it.
sourceHeadline: OpenAI says AI agents carried out an 'unprecedented' autonomous hack
